title: Preparation of Permeable Porous Alumina Ceramics by Gel Casting Combined with Particle Stacking and Sintering Method
content: Porous ceramics have been widely used in various fields. In this paper, porous ceramics with through-hole structure were prepared using a novel and eco-friendly gel casting method with carrageenan as gelling agent. Especially, the idea of large size particle staking is introduced into the gel casting process. By introducing large size alumina aggregates as raw materials, and small size micropowders as filling materials, micropores were directly formed after the green body was sintered. To tune the pore size, pore structure, gas permeability, and the strength of final porous ceramics, the component of the raw materials including the alumina aggregates, the filling materials, and sintering additives in the slurry were concisely designed. Porous Al2O3 based ceramics with high gas permeability, high flexural strength, and moderate porosity were finally obtained.
